newsitem.title: UK: UK's FTSE up but rates, inflation fears cap gains.
newsitem.headline: UK's FTSE up but rates, inflation fears cap gains.

text.p: The London stock market pushed higher in early trade on Friday as gilts rebounded but nagging fears about inflation and interest rates after a strong CBI retail sales report were likely to brake momentum.

The FTSE 100 share index, which shed 35 points on Thursday amid massive pressure from futures markets, recouped some losses on Friday and was up 11.9 points at 3,912.3 some 15 minutes after the start of official trade.
"With gilts flying we're probably going to do better than yesterday but, with inflation fears around, people are still scared this market will crack," a senior equities dealer said.
